protocol: One fixed 45-case test. Total 107 images. Compare unchanged 30-case policy, 46 local-reference fit cases and maximum 62 fit cases = 46 plus 16 whose reference trajectory uses search. The latter supply blind four-tool local review and answer-label feedback only. Same tool budget, zero search. Cases with four calls at incumbent stop are attempted but cannot supply a feasible extra-action transition. Refit same feature HCL and pick between same two SkillOpt edits on fit data only. No gate or deployment selection after merging the original 16 gate records into fit. Report gains/losses/retention versus 9 and actual logical tool costs. On fixed answers also check question-aware scoring. Fit collection sharded by case; no test use in fitting.
